search.query: `corelight_idx` `corelight_st_intel` OR `corelight_evt_suri` OR (`corelight_st_notice` note=*) sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$| eval clevent=coalesce('seen.indicator_type','note','alert.signature') | stats count by clevent, sourcetype | sort -count | rename clevent AS Events count AS Count

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` `corelight_st_intel` OR `corelight_evt_suri` OR (`corelight_st_notice` note=*) sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$ | eval clevent=coalesce('seen.indicator_type','note','alert.signature') | search clevent = "$click.value$"&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$
